title: Exception-awareness

questions.text: Is there an exception in current state that overrides the learned default?

inputs: delegations, departures and explicit customer instructions in state and activities

criteria.text: an exception holds in the current state
criteria.guide: Delegation, departure, or the customer's own explicit request that overrides a default.
The action does not force the learned default back in when an exception holds.

failure_examples: “Keep champion involved” should not apply when the champion explicitly delegated the process.

labels.label: EXCEPTION_HONORED
labels.when: An exception holds and the candidate respects it (or no default is wrongly applied).

labels.label: EXCEPTION_MISSED
labels.when: An exception holds and the candidate applies the overridden default anyway.
